scope: Consumer-facing online shopping comparison and affiliate referral platform

owner_provided_inputs.customer_problem: Online shoppers currently open multiple applications to compare product prices and discounts.
platform_value: Aggregate external merchant links in one platform.
Rank comparable offers from top to bottom by the approved ranking policy.
Maintain price history so users can understand price movement.
owner_provided_inputs.transaction_model: Users purchase on external merchant platforms through referral links; the platform is not the checkout marketplace for this model.
owner_provided_inputs.reward_model: Post-confirmation affiliate reward points; the user can use points only after the merchant confirms the referral/order.
owner_provided_inputs.confirmation_timing: The user described confirmation as arriving after approximately two months; exact partner-specific confirmation periods remain to be supplied.
owner_provided_inputs.marketing_model: Use selected high-referral products to provide gifts to some users as a marketing mechanism and encourage repeat visits.
product_prioritization_direction: Prioritize products searched frequently across approved sources during the most recent two-month period.
Then consider products with higher referral margin.
owner_provided_inputs.future_scope: The owner may add first-party products in a future phase; this is not part of the current external-referral pilot unless separately approved.

reward_allocation_statement_as_provided: The user described an example in which a 4% referral commission could be allocated as 1.5% to customer points, 1.5% to the owner's allocation, and 1% to platform scaling and maintenance, with no user-charged platform fee.
unresolved_items: The phrase '40% ka' is ambiguous relative to the 4% example: the exact denominator and allocation basis must be confirmed.
